title: Lean Builder Brief
outcome: A lean builder brief: one product requirements document with use cases and a learning log, so a small team can build with confidence.

minimumInputs.help: What need does this meet, or what outcome should it produce?
minimumInputs.example: Invoices approved within five days instead of nine.

minimumInputs.help: Who will build from this brief?
minimumInputs.example: A freelance developer using a no-code tool.

minimumInputs.help: Which user steps do you know, and what limits apply?
minimumInputs.example: Supplier uploads invoice, sees status, gets an email when paid; must work on mobile.

minimumInputs.help: What problem are you solving, and for whom?
minimumInputs.example: Managers miss approval deadlines because invoices arrive by email and get buried.

minimumInputs.help: Who is the main user of what will be built?
minimumInputs.example: Approving managers who receive invoices for sign-off.

minimumInputs.help: What will be different when this is solved?
minimumInputs.example: Invoices approved in five days and early-payment discounts captured.

minimumInputs.help: What do you propose to include in this product version?
minimumInputs.example: Invoice capture, approval routing by amount, and posting to finance.

minimumInputs.help: What research or evidence do you have, and what limits apply? Say "none yet" if so.
minimumInputs.example: Interviews with six managers; must integrate with the current finance system.

minimumInputs.help: Who (or what system) carries out this use case?
minimumInputs.example: An approving manager.

minimumInputs.help: What is the actor trying to achieve?
minimumInputs.example: Approve an invoice that is within their spending limit.

minimumInputs.help: What does this cover, and what is outside it?
minimumInputs.example: Invoice approval in the new workflow; payment runs are outside.

minimumInputs.help: Describe the normal steps, and any conditions you know (before, after, exceptions).
minimumInputs.example: Manager opens invoice, checks it against the order, approves; invoices over the limit go to a director.

minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Any step Kryterea proposes rather than takes from you is marked as proposed.
What do you believe is true but have not proven? Write it as a guess you can test.
minimumInputs.example: Suppliers who can see invoice status will stop emailing accounts payable.

minimumInputs.help: How could you test that guess quickly and cheaply? Or describe a test you already ran.
minimumInputs.example: Email ten suppliers a status link for two weeks and count follow-up emails.

minimumInputs.prompt: Distinguish planned work from observed results
minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Planned steps and real results are kept apart, so nothing is reported as done before it happened.
What does the solution cover, and where does it stop?
minimumInputs.example: The approval web app and its email notifications.

minimumInputs.help: Who uses it, what data does it handle, and where or when does it run?
minimumInputs.example: Around 40 managers, invoice and supplier data, used in office hours across two countries.

minimumInputs.help: Which qualities matter most, such as speed, security, availability or accessibility?
minimumInputs.example: Security of supplier bank details, and pages loading in under two seconds.

minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Any number you have not given (for example a response time) is proposed and marked for confirmation.
What question should the prototype answer?
minimumInputs.example: Can a manager approve an invoice on a phone without help?

minimumInputs.help: Who will try the prototype, and in what situation?
minimumInputs.example: A manager approving three invoices between meetings.

minimumInputs.help: What will the prototype include, and what will it fake or leave out?
minimumInputs.example: Clickable approval screens only; no real data or login.

minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Findings are only recorded from real test sessions, never assumed.

minimumInputs.prompt: Scope/requirements or explicit draft acceptance goals
minimumInputs.help: What will be tested? Paste the requirements, or describe what "working" means in your words.
minimumInputs.example: Managers can approve, reject and delegate invoices; approved invoices post to finance.

minimumInputs.help: Who will do the acceptance testing?
minimumInputs.example: Two approving managers and one accounts payable clerk.

minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Anything not yet known about the test environment is recorded as open.
